title: eat shit & die 211
author: bpatrick

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.html:
I’m hoping everybody is seeing the new MSFM because it is kind of hidden in there, seeing as how the previous/next button doesn’t cross between albums.
The colouring and shading looks fantastic and I like these detailed cityscapes the es&d characters live in. You should find some time on of these evenings to crank out another comic (if you want my vote, make another Onan). I know; those Onan’s probably take hours to draw with all those pipes and stars and creepy robots and gorgeous robots.
Of course, I really like the output of comics you’ve done so far. This could quite possibly be the Summer of Comics.
